description: Defines types, constants, and inline functions for audio processing, including coefficient and sample manipulations, within the Android Open Source Project.

methods.name: mul_coef_sample
methods.description: Multiplies a coefficient by a sample, returning an accumulator.

methods.name: mac_coef_sample
methods.description: Multiplies a coefficient by a sample and adds to an accumulator.

methods.name: coef_sample_acc_to_sample
methods.description: Converts an accumulator to a sample value.

methods.name: s15_to_audio_sample_t
methods.description: Converts a 16-bit signed integer (S15) to an audio sample.

methods.name: audio_sample_t_to_s15
methods.description: Converts an audio sample to S15 format without clipping.

methods.name: audio_sample_t_to_s15_clip
methods.description: Converts an audio sample to S15 format with clipping.
